method: Agent-operated real browser through the visible application controls
scope: Fictional scenarios and local browser workflow. These are not completed customer PoCs or an independent human review.

checks.name: Northstar starts with managed workflows, then changes to cloud events after the five-second requirement
Edited executive summary survives the changed requirement and is flagged stale
Actual downloaded seven-file ZIP contains revision 2, pinned revision 1, five-second requirement and the authored wording
Mark reviewed clears the stale flag and preserves the authored wording
Unsupported JSON import displays an error and preserves the current draft
Actual exported brief re-imports and survives page reload
Harbour starts with the private service; managed-only staffing blocks every option
All-blocked proposal explicitly limits the plan to discovery with no implementation schedule
Lumen changes from cloud events to the private service when public processing is prohibited
390 by 844 viewport has no document horizontal overflow; the cost table scrolls inside its own container
Mobile navigation opens, changes views, closes on selection and closes on Escape
Invalid zero-second freshness disables export; reload restores the last valid five-second saved brief
Rate review changes conditional fit to fit; a subsequent labour-rate edit clears that review
No warning or error console entries on the final local browser tab

limitations: Basic keyboard and responsive checks are not a complete accessibility audit.
One stale preview tab encountered a transient connection failure during a Vite restart. A fresh tab restored the valid saved draft.
